chrome_hint: eBay AU sold and completed: 'B&W DM602 speakers', 'B&W DM603 speakers', 'B&W DM601 floorstanding', 'Bowers Wilkins DM600 pair' (Sold items, Australia, last 12 months; Terapeak if signed in). Also Gumtree/Facebook Marketplace 'B&W DM602' and 'B&W DM603' for Tasmania and mainland asking prices, plus Mitchell/Leilo/Lawsons sold results for 'B&W floorstanding speakers'. Note whether sellers say pickup only (floorstanders are heavy, freight lowers resale).
viewing_check: Read the model label on the rear terminal panel or the badge (DM601/602/603/604 etc, and S2/S3 suffix) and photograph it. Check the drivers: foam or rubber surrounds perished, tweeter dome dents, bass cone damage. Check the grille fabric and cabinet veneer lifting. If possible, connect an amp and confirm both speakers sound on all drivers. Confirm the pair is matched (both same model).
